messages:
Lia Vendor: Hi team — quick update from our side on the APAC allocation and the RMA pool. We have 18 H100 units available to re-route, ETA to SGN dock is 5-7 business days. :ship:
Sam Ops: Copy. Are those fresh units or depot refurb?
Lia Vendor: Fresh units but flagged as 'depot reserve' for warranty swaps. Vendor wants a holdback of 2 units as buffer for DOA claims.
Maria Supply: We need at least 4 loaners for the Singapore cluster while replacements arrive. Can we convert 2 of the 18 to short-term loaners?
Lia Vendor: Yes, we can reclass 2 as loaners, but expedite air will cost +$1,200 unit. Sea is cheaper but adds 7 days.
Alex Eng: SGN rack power is also constrained this week; if we push H200 instead of H100 we might avoid re-cabling. Can vendor swap any H200 equivalents?
Lia Vendor: No direct H200 inventory in APAC right now. We can offer H200 in EU pool and cross-ship, but customs + transit will be long (~14 days) and more expensive.
Jordan PL: Cost question — how do we split expedite fees vs vendor warranty responsibility? Our finance prefers vendor absorb DOA expedite for first 3 replacements.
Lia Vendor: We can absorb one expedite per incident, additional expedite fees split 50/50.
Sam Ops: Noted. Can you send AWB and manifest once booked? We need serials to pre-stage in inventory.
Lia Vendor: Will do. Preliminary AWBs when available. Example manifest format below:
```
AWB,SKU,SERIAL,TYPE
SKY123456789,H100,SN-H100-001,loaner
SKY123456790,H100,SN-H100-002,loaner
SKY123456791,H100,SN-H100-003,replacement
```
LogiBot: Reminder — add HS code 8473.30 for customs clearance to avoid delays.
Maria Supply: Also need proforma with insurance valuation; raise value to cover replacement cost + freight.
Lia Vendor: Understood. I'll push proforma and updated AWBs within 24h.
Alex Eng: One more ask — can vendor mark two replacements as "no-foam" packing? Our depot moved to foamless pallets and it speeds unpacking.
Lia Vendor: Yes, we can accommodate foamless for the 2 loaners.
Sam Ops: Action items: 1) Lia to send AWB + proforma in 24h. 2) Lia to reserve 2 loaners and 2-unit holdback. 3) Maria to prepare depot intake slot and customs docs. 4) Alex to confirm power workarounds at SGN.
Jordan PL: Fine with the 50/50 after first absorbed expedite. Please ping if vendor changes. :thumbsup:
Lia Vendor: Will do. Thanks all. :pray:
Sam Ops: Thanks — tagging @LogiBot to create intake ticket when AWB arrives.
LogiBot: Ticket created: #INTAKE-6421 once AWB attached.
